extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the browser toolbar and extensions management page.

extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers, and silently closes popup/redirect tabs, without nag screens.
extDescription.description: The extension's short description, shown on the extensions management page and store listing.

popupOnboardingCard.message: Moat blocks ads and trackers automatically. Use the switch below to pause it on a site, or Settings to fine-tune.

popupPausedSuffix.message: . Reload the page to see it unblocked.

popupLoadError.message: Couldn't load status. Try reopening the popup.

optionsTagline.message: Blocks ads, trackers, and hijacked popups.

optionsMasterToggleHint.message: Toggle to turn off all blocking globally.

optionsCookiesToggleHint.message: Prevents cross site tracking across your browser. (Off by default)

optionsWebrtcToggleHint.message: Hides your real IP address when using a VPN.

optionsFingerprintToggleHint.message: Scrambles device data to prevent silent tracking. May occasionally break site features like CAPTCHAs. (Off by default)

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleHint.message: Generates fresh noise each time your browser restarts instead of reusing the same noise forever, closer to Brave's model. A fingerprint that never changes can itself become a stable identifier over time; rotating trades that off against sites seeing a different "device" on every browser restart. (Off by default)

optionsGrayscaleToggleHint.message: Automatically grays out embedded video ads like YouTube that cannot be entirely removed.

optionsFeedScanToggleHint.message: Scans and removes sponsored or promoted posts from social feeds as you scroll. (Off by default)

optionsConsentRejectToggleHint.message: Automatically clicks reject or decline on major consent banners. (Off by default)

optionsCnameToggleHint.message: Detects and blocks trackers hiding behind first party subdomains. (Off by default)

optionsLiveListHint.message: Fetches the latest popup and redirect blocks daily from GitHub.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Protection is completely disabled on these hostnames.

optionsFilterBudgetWarning.message: Some filter lists may not be fully active. Your browser's shared rule budget is often exceeded when several ad-blocking or filter-heavy extensions are installed at once -- try disabling other such extensions, or turning off a filter list below.

optionsIndividualListsHint.message: Fine tune your active filters. Changing these will switch your level to Custom.

optionsBlockedSitesHint.message: Always block these domains regardless of filter lists.

optionsAllowedSitesHint.message: Never block these domains, bypassing all active filter lists.

optionsHiddenElementsHint.message: Elements you removed using the "Block an element" toolbar tool. Remove them here to restore them.

optionsDimmedElementsHint.message: Elements you selected to "Gray out". Remove them here to restore normal visibility.

optionsPrivacyIntro.message: Everything on this page is stored locally in your browser and never leaves your device.

optionsBackupIntro.message: Save your settings to a file, or load a previously saved one. Your device's fingerprint-resistance identifier is never included.

optionsSyncToggleHint.message: Mirrors your settings through your browser's own sync account. Off by default. Seeds a new install once; doesn't live-merge changes made on two devices at once.

presetHintEssential.message: Ads, popups, and known-malicious sites only.

presetHintStandard.message: Standard level blocks ads, trackers, and known malicious sites.

presetHintStrict.message: Everything, plus the browser-wide privacy toggles above.

presetHintCustom.message: A mix you've put together yourself.

optionsLiveStatusFailed.message: Last attempt failed ($WHEN$) — using the bundled baseline until the next try.

optionsImportedInvalid.message: That file doesn't look like a valid Moat settings export.

leakedPasswordWarning.message: This password has appeared in known data breaches.

optionsLeakedPasswordToggleHint.message: Warns if a password you type has appeared in a known data breach. Only a partial hash ever leaves your device. (Off by default)
